Hi there! Shopping for your cat? 🐱 Let us help you find the right fit to match their energy.
Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
Yes—address changes are possible only until a shipping label has been created, and they are not guaranteed because orders are processed quickly.
From One Fast Cat's policy:
- Before the shipping label is created: they may be able to update the address.
- After the label is created: UPS or FedEx controls the change, and a $17 fee applies for an address correction.
- Once the package is out for delivery, the address can no longer be changed.
- They also cannot change an order to an international address, PO Box, or non-contiguous U.S. state/territory.
If you want me to check your specific order, please log in and I can look it up. You can also review the policy here: Order Changes & Shipping Address Changes.

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
No. Once an order is placed, One Fast Cat cannot modify the items on it, including adding products, removing products, or changing quantities or colors.
If the order has not shipped yet, they may be able to cancel it so you can place a new order with the additional item. Cancellations are not guaranteed because orders are processed quickly, and once an order has shipped it cannot be canceled.
Policy page: Order Changes & Shipping Address Changes

turns.q: If I cancel, how long until I'm refunded?
turns.replyTail:
l, how long until I'm refunded?
If your cancellation is successfully processed, partial refunds for order adjustments that have not shipped yet are typically issued within 24 hours. After the refund is issued, it usually appears within 2–3 business days, though some banks and payment processors can take 5–7 business days.
One Fast Cat also notes that cancellations are not guaranteed once an order is placed because orders are processed quickly.
You can review their policy here: Terms & Conditions
